A highly motivated, results -oriented sustainability leader with over 14 years of total work experience, including a 9 -year track record of driving 
sustainable business transformation and creating long -term value. Having proven expertise in developing and executing comprehensive ESG 
strategies, implementing sustainable business practices, and fostering stakeholder engagement to mitigate risk and enhance br and image. Adept at 
managing high-performing, cross-functional teams and engaging with C-suite executives, investors and regulatory bodies. 
Experience includes overseeing the implementation of ESG reporting frameworks such as GRI, BRSR, TCFD and SASB; GHG inventory  
development; climate  risk management; decarbonization; value chain sustainability; responsible financing, implementing business  
management  systems; facilitating  audits  and building  constructive  relationships.  Passionate  about  translating  complex  environmental data 
into clear and actionable insights. Transparent disclosures through Integrated Annual Reporting, stakeholder interactions and  responses  
against  rating requirements  have led  to top -tier ESG ratings.  
Consultation  provided  for various  industry  sectors  namely  BFSI, Oil and Gas, Renewable  Energy,  FMCG,  IT, Electronic  and Heavy 
Machinery manufacturers and Shipping.  
Professional  qualification  includes  M. Tech,  certificate  course  on tropical  coastal  ecosystems  and certified  lead auditor  for EMS.

Professional Experience 
Deputy Vice President – ESG | Kotak Mahindra Bank Ltd., Mumbai  Sep 2019 - Sep 2025  
This role is pivotal in integrating ESG principles into core business strategy, requiring a forward -thinking approach  to sustainability, 
policy evolution and stakeholder alignment. It involves aligning ESG priorities with strategic goals, redesigning policies an d processes 
for resilience and leading both voluntary and compliance -based disclosures.  
Key deliverables include the Integrated  Annual Report, BRSR  and GHG Inventory  along with water and  waste, Climate Risk assessment 
along with stakeholder engagement and assurance coordination. Designing and implementing comprehensive framework for responsi ble 
financing  by embedding  ESG considerations  into the core operations  (energy,  water, waste etc) of the Bank. The role also required  to 
drive sustainability initiatives, fosters best practice adoption  and leading materiality assessments. A  critical focus is  on modernizing ESG 
data systems —transitioning  from legacy  methods  to agile, tech-enabled  platforms  for real-time insights.  
 
Senior Lead Consultant  – Sustainable Development | Goodera (formerly Nextgen PMS Ltd.), Mumbai  Feb 2017 - Sep 2019  
Spearheaded end-to-end sustainability  projects across diverse industries,  ensuring strategic alignment and timely execution.  The 
responsibilities  were to develop and implement ESG Strategy, develop customized ESG frameworks,  policies, and implementation 
roadmaps and facilitation of materiality assessments through stakeholder consultations to prioritize ESG issues effectively. Delivered 
gap analyses, peer reviews and actionable recommendations to enhance ESG performance.  
Conducting  workshops  and training  sessions  to build ESG literacy  across  client organizations.  Value chain assessment  was one of the 
prime roles which included  evaluation  of supply  chain  partners  against  sustainability  benchmarks  through  structured  audits.  Authored 
ESG reports  developed  in-line with GRI, TCFD,  SASB,  BRR and similar such frameworks  and coordinated  the third-party verification 
and assurance  processes.  Drafted  project  proposals  and contributed  to award  applications  by curating  compelling  sustainability 
narratives. 
Analyst  – Knowledge  Management | Prudential Process Management Services, Mumbai  Dec 2015 -March 2016  
Led end -to-end project management initiatives focused on transforming complex business challenges into strategic Knowledge 
Management  (KM) solutions. Executed  the development  of comprehensive  KM frameworks,  optimized existing  knowledge repositories 
and designed scalable processes for KM systems, ensuring seamless ongoing governance of enterprise knowledge assets.  
Authored high -impact project proposals and established standardized operating procedures to facilitate the effective retrieval of internal 
knowledge, along with mechanism to organize and utilize it across multiple concurrent projects in a fast -paced, deadline -driven 
environments. Played a pivotal role in formulating and implementing strategies to position and enhance vertical offerings for  key 
stakeholders  and prospective  clients.  Maintained  consistent  delivery  of high-quality  services  by cultivating  strong,  trust-based 
relationships  with primary  stakeholders,  driving  alignment  between  business  objectives  and KM initiatives.  
 
Consultant - Management Systems (HSE & CSR) | Q Factor Consulting Pvt Ltd, Mumbai  Oct 2013 – Dec 2015  
Conducted market research, developed strategic plans and long -term goal to drive organizational growth and client success. Delivered 
expert consultancy across Quality, Environment, Health & Safety, Waste Management and Food Safety for multi-sector clients. Provided 
end-to-end support on certification guidance, product development, process mapping, documentation, training, audits and management 
reviews. Spearheaded business development  by identifying opportunities, conducting  negotiations and ensure client retention through 
tailored solutions and innovative service offerings.  
Faculty  | CLIMB  FIRST, Mumbai Aug 2012 – July 2013 
Delivered  lectures  and developed  curriculums  for competitive  exam  aspirants.  Maintained  strong  student  engagement,  provided 
structured  resources  and resolved  subject -related queries.  Managed  assessments,  prepared  and evaluated  test papers,  monitored 
assignment  completion  and offered timely  feedback  to guide student  progress.  
Microbiologist (QA) | J.P INDIA PRODUCTS, Mathura  Feb 2012 – Jun 2012  
Perform microbiological analysis (sample collection, detection, enumeration, confirmation and verification) of water and air; equipment 
and surfaces.  Responsible for the preparation and storage  of reference organisms,  maintenance & calibration of equipment,  monitoring 
effectiveness of water treatment plant. Supervise & monitor sanitation, hygiene practices, follow GMP, food safety and manage  all 
microbiology related activity of the plant.  
 
Research Scholar (R&D) | Actis Biologics Pvt Ltd, Mumbai  Jul 2011 – Jan 2012 
Purification of proteins using chromatography methods, gel electrophoresis, immuno -precipitation etc. Target protein isolation to
